higher_level: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level 3 or higher, use the higher level wherever the spell's level appears in the stat block.

name: Summon Aberration
material_specified: a pickled tentacle and an eyeball in a platinum-inlaid vial worth 400+ GP
desc: You call forth a nonphysical aberrant spirit. It manifests in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. This corporeal form uses the Aberrant Spirit stat block. When you cast the spell, choose a Form of the spirit: Beholderkin, Mind Flayer, or Slaad. The creature resembles an Aberration of your choice that matches the chosen form, which determines certain traits in its stat block. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends. The creature is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, the creature shares your Initiative count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands.
higher_level: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level 5 or higher, use the higher level wherever the spell's level appears in the stat block.

name: Find Greater Steed
material_specified: a bit of fur from a horse
desc: You summon a spirit that assumes the form of a loyal, majestic mount. Choose the form: a griffon, a pegasus, a peryton, a dire wolf, a rhinoceros, or a sabre-toothed tiger. The spirit takes on the statistics of the chosen form, though it is a Celestial, a Fey, or a Fiend (your choice) instead of its normal creature type. It appears in an unoccupied space within range and acts as your mount. It obeys your commands, and you can dismiss it. If it is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it disappears. While mounted on it, you can make any attack that targets a creature other than the mount. The steed has its own turn.

name: Power Word Fortify
desc: You fortify the life force of up to six creatures you can see within range, causing them to gain Temporary Hit Points equal to the caster's spellcasting ability modifier plus 20.

name: Benediction
material_specified: a drop of holy water
desc: You bless up to six creatures of your choice within range. Until the spell ends, each target has a bonus to its next ability check, attack roll, or saving throw equal to your spellcasting ability modifier, as specified when the spell is cast.

name: Tidal Wave
material_specified: a drop of water
desc: You conjure up a wave of water that crashes down on an area within range. The area can be up to 30 feet long, up to 10 feet wide, and up to 10 feet tall. Each creature in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 4d8 Bludgeoning damage and has the Prone condition. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't knocked Prone. The water then disperses.
higher_level: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level 4 or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 3.

name: Wall of Sand
material_specified: a handful of sand
desc: You conjure up a wall of swirling sand on the ground at a point you can see within range. You can make the wall up to 30 feet long, 10 feet high, and 10 feet thick, and you can shape it in any way you choose so long as it makes one continuous path along the ground. The wall blocks line of sight. Each creature in the wall's area must make a Strength saving throw or have the Blinded condition while it is in the wall. A creature can move through the wall, but it is Difficult Terrain. A creature in the wall takes 2d4 Force damage for every 5 feet it moves.

name: Flame Arrows
material_specified: a drop of oil
desc: You touch a quiver containing arrows or bolts. When a target is hit by a ranged weapon attack using a piece of ammunition drawn from the quiver, the target takes an extra 1d6 Fire damage. The spell's magic ends on a piece of ammunition when it hits or misses. The spell ends when you withdraw twelve pieces of ammunition from the quiver or when the duration expires.
higher_level: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level 4 or higher, the number of pieces of ammunition you can affect increases by two for each slot level above 3.

name: Guardian of Nature
desc: A nature spirit answers your call and transforms you into a powerful guardian. Until the spell ends, you gain one of the following benefits of your choice: Great Tree: You gain 10 Temporary Hit Points, and when you hit with a melee weapon attack you can choose to have it deal an extra 1d6 Force damage. Primal Beast: Your Speed increases by 10 feet, and your attacks with unarmed strikes and natural weapons deal an extra 1d6 Force damage. Your unarmed strikes and natural weapons have a reach of 10 feet.

name: Primal Savagery
desc: You channel primal magic to cause your teeth or fingernails to sharpen, ready to deliver a corrosive attack. Make a melee spell attack against one creature within 5 feet of you. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Acid damage.
higher_level: When you reach levels 5, 11, and 17, the damage increases by 1d10: 2d10 at level 5, 3d10 at level 11, and 4d10 at level 17.
